Senses.Explanation: Zhong Kui is the legendary demon-queller, attested 70 times in 43 allowlisted texts. Chan records do not retell a complete outside biography; they put his name and familiar attributes to work in public answers, festival speech, verse, and appraisal. Asked for “the host within the guest,” Wuzu Fayan answers, “Zhong Kui's little sister” (鍾馗小妹). At the Double-Fifth festival, after a student says that a little ghost might display a trick, Wuzu Fayan replies, “Zhong Kui will frighten you” (鍾馗嚇你), then speaks of a protective talisman. Xiaoyin Xin makes the demon-queller dance eighteen beats (鍾馗解舞十八拍); Panshan Dabo Qian pictures him on a wall beside swords hanging in space (壁上畵鍾馗，空中懸劍戟); and Fushan Fayuan says at New Year that no strange thing is presently before them, so there is no need to paste up Zhong Kui (目前無異怪，不用貼鍾馗). His name can also be an unglossed answer: asked how to discuss words with no trace, Dongshan Shouchu says, “Zhong Kui does not read books” (鍾馗不讀書). The Zen-specific bend is this repeated deployment of the demon-catching figure, his household, dance, painted image, and protective posting as encounter answers and teaching-seat language; no further symbolic meaning is assigned.
Senses.Note: Family research covered the little sister, frightening ghosts, dancing, wall depiction, New Year posting, and the no-books answer. These are deployments of the same named figure, not separate readings or referents.

Occurrences.Kwic: 學云。如何是主中賓。師云。鍾馗小妹。學云。如何是主中主。師云。一言纔出口。地上繡絪開。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Wuzu Fayan, in 法演禪師語錄 (Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Fayan), answers the four-rank interview with 'Zhong Kui's little sister.'

Occurrences.Kwic: 進云也待小鬼做箇伎倆師云鍾馗嚇你乃云今日端午莭白雲有一道神符也有些小靈驗
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Wuzu Fayan, in 古尊宿語錄 (Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters), answers the Double-Fifth exchange and introduces a protective talisman.

Occurrences.Kwic: 直得張公喫酒李公醉，鍾馗解舞十八拍，金鷄唱曉，石女遊春。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Xiaoyin Xin, in 列祖提綱錄 (Compendium of Essentials from the Patriarchs), delivers the New Year's Eve address containing Zhong Kui's dance.

Occurrences.Kwic: 壁上畵鍾馗，空中懸劍戟。施大用，展全機，戴角擎頭覩者稀
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Panshan Dabo Qian, in 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷) (Complete Book of the Five Lamps), places a painted Zhong Kui and suspended swords in his verse.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問新歲已臨舊歲何往。師曰。目前無異怪。不用貼鍾馗。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Fushan Fayuan, in 續傳燈錄 (Continued Record of the Transmission of the Lamp), answers where the old year goes when the new arrives.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問言無眹跡如何理論師云鍾馗不讀書
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Dongshan Shouchu, in 古尊宿語錄 (Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters), answers how to discuss words without traces.
